notes.title: Heartbeats Official Release!
notes.notes:
You can now face your Heart in the full experience! After the latest adjustments, we can finally say that the development is complete! All that's left now is to play! 

Enjoy:  

 5 unique characters, each with their own goals and skins
 Every run is different from the last, for a varied experience
 A constant challenge to stay on top of the global leaderboards
 Dynamic music and sound that adapt to the flow of the game


We’re truly excited to share this news and to bring you the game in its final form! A huge thank you to everyone who supported us and believed in us, giving us the push to reach this point. 
Thank you so much!!
Now...

it's time to overcome the anxiety!

notes.title: Hotfix Localization
notes.notes: We've fixed a small bug affecting locale selection on startup for localization. Sorry for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Heartbeats Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Welcome back to another weekly update for Heartbeats!

This week, we’re excited to announce several major updates to enhance your demo experience.
As mentioned on our Discord, this will likely be our last major update for the demo as we 
focus on bringing even more exciting features.

Full changelog below:

Quality of Lifes

 New! Tutorial! It's now clearer what's going on.
 New! Nightmare Mechanic! From now on, if you lose a life while inside a nightmare, the nightmare will end.
 New! 40,000 Achievement! Get ready to flex those gaming skills!


So buckle up, because we’re shifting into high gear as we race toward the official release!

notes.title: Heartbeats Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Welcome back with this new weekly update!

We are cooking hard to deliver the best experience possible and making exciting progress on boss mechanics!
In the meantime, we've made a few minor improvements to the demo, especially with the leaderboards.

Quality of Life

 Leaderboard usernames now fit better in both Global and Friends views! 
 Fixed a bug where the last element on a leaderboard page wasn’t showing. 
 Fixed a bug where an additional, empty leaderboard page was being displayed.
 New Rich Presence in Options, Leaderboard and Inner Weapon selection!


Make sure to join our Discord to get more detailed updates!

notes.title: Heartbeats Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Here we are with the weekly update!

Here at First Impact Studio, we never stop delivering updates and making space for your ideas to fit into the game. After many, many (did I already say many?) requests, our programmer just unleashed their inner power ( caffeine ) and delivered a complete leaderboard updgrade.

You heard right. The game now support not only local scoring but global and friends too. 
Unleash your inner self and keep your heartbeats high.

Full changelog below:

Quality of Life

 New! Killchain break animation! The sound now fit better with the art!
 New! Leaderboard Revamped! Keep an eye on your friends and climb to the top!

Make sure to join our Discord, send your feedback, and first to get early updates!

notes.title: Heartbeats Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Welcome back to the weekly update! We’re always here with fresh news to keep you in the loop!

Last week, we launched our "Open Localization Program" to help you introduce new languages based on your needs. It was a huge success! Thanks to Nolan, Heartbeats now has full French support! If you wanna get involved in the program, make sure to join our Discord first!

Updates

We've done some *bip* *bup* *clank* ("fix" sounds boring) with a full changelog below.

Quality of Life

 New! Full French Localization Support ( Nolan ❤️ )
 New! Added an Epilepsy Warning at startup, just to keep everyone safe.
 New! Bullets now vanish more smoothly during stage transitions and other game moments.
 New! The Tutorial reset now matches the in-game reset better, so it feels more consistent.

Fixes

 UI Prompts are now a bit bigger. You don’t have to squint to see them!
 Fixed a bug with Harmony shooting. Bullets were sneaking past enemies without hitting them when close. We’ve sorted that out! 
 Moved the reset button on keyboard from "space" to "esc" so now it's a bit more convenient!
 Turned up the ability recharge volume just a tad so you can hear it better, but it won’t be too noisy.
 Tidied up the letters on the Ranking screen for a cleaner look.
 Fixed the Italian and English Localization.


See you next week, stay tuned!

notes.title: Heartbeats Demo Update!
notes.notes:
This week has been intense! Last week, we released the demo, and you provided us with tons of helpful feedback that will significantly aid in the development of the game. By the way, if you haven't done so yet, hop on our Discord and let us know your thoughts about the demo!

We've fixed some bugs and made adjustments to create a smoother, more accessible experience while keeping your heart engaged.

For additional details, please check out the full changelog below.

Updates

Fixes

 Fixed a bug that prevented the game from continuing after pressing "retry" following the tutorial.

Quality of Life

 You can now exit the tutorial at any time, so if you accidentally enter it, you're no longer stuck watching the whole sequence.
 The timing of the tutorial sequence has been shortened, making it more responsive and less frustrating.

Accessibility

 Added a slider to adjust the game's master volume.


But that's not all!
Alongside more updates coming in the next few weeks, we've also added a new achievement in the demo. The challenge is set: will you conquer it, or will your anxieties overwhelm you?
